title: Paṭhamapaṭipattisuttaṃ
text: 31 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . ‘‘Micchāpaṭipattiñca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, sammāpaṭipattiñca . Taṃ suṇātha. Katamā ca, bhikkhave, micchāpaṭipatti? Seyyathidaṃ – micchādiṭṭhi…pe… micchāsamādhi. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, micchāpaṭipatti. Katamā ca, bhikkhave, sammāpaṭipatti? Seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi…pe… sammāsamādhi. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammāpaṭipattī’’ti. Paṭhamaṃ.
